correctness.rationale: The normalized molecules (e_x−e_y)/d(x,y) generate the free-space unit ball; averaging over ∏S(A_i) yields contractive Q and P=I−Q. P fixes within-cluster molecules with norm 1. For cross-cluster molecules, explicit transportation upper plan and admissible dual potential both yield w_i+w_j, hence ∥P∥=max(1,w_(1)+w_(2)). Symmetrizing ANY bounded projection R onto U under the same permutation group gives P because V is the fixed subspace and U has no invariant vectors; thus ∥R∥≥∥P∥. Reviewed and checked exact-rational supplied certificate structure, and independent sample thresholds (two 3-clusters radius1 give 4/3). Universal proof does not rely on 263-case finite diagnostic.
